sourceManifest.note: SHA-256 of the sorted path and content-SHA manifest before evidence/checkpoint files were added.

themes.gradientTextNote: The automated evaluator cannot derive a colour from transparent background-clipped gradient text. The three actual gradient stops were checked independently at 10.41:1, 7.10:1 and 9.19:1 against the rendered background, all above the 3:1 large-text threshold.

focus.customDialog: Initial focus, Tab and Shift+Tab containment, Escape cancellation, and previous-focus restoration implemented.

semantics.ocadeDemo: Accessibility tree exposes banner, navigation, main, named composer, named disabled Attach and Voice controls, and Send.
semantics.notFound: Unknown URL exposes main, 404 heading, explanation, and Go home recovery link.
semantics.notFoundRecovery: Go home was activated and navigation recovered to /.
semantics.errorAlerts: Root route error surfaces expose role=alert inside a main landmark.

limits: This is real rendered-browser evidence, not evidence from a physical screen reader.
Authenticated product routes were not entered because no user credentials were supplied.
The static zero-baseline gate covers only decidable source defects; contrast and focus are supported by this separate rendered-runtime evidence.
